note: Known-true answers, already shipping in the firmware's vehicle profile and validated on the truck. The scanner must rediscover these before it is trusted on a vehicle nobody has mapped. A tool that cannot find answers we already know is broken, and that must be discovered in your own driveway rather than during a borrowed truck's one session.

must_find.why: transmission fluid temperature — the project's original crux; matches the dash DIC
EGT block — multi-frame ISO-TP, 3 sensors behind a presence mask; proves fragment assembly works
MAP — found only because the enhanced 2200xx range mirrors the generic 01xx block
intake air temperature — the other half of the mirror-block discovery
DEF level — the byte[3] fix; byte[1] is concentration and reads stuck
